## Type of Change

- [ ] New feature (`feat`)
- [ ] Bug fix (`fix`)
- [ ] Refactor (`refactor`)
- [ ] Documentation (`docs`)
- [ ] Tests (`test`)
- [ ] Configuration / dependencies (`chore`)
- [ ] Breaking change

**Tested on:**

- [ ] iOS
- [ ] Android
- [ ] Simulator / emulator

## Author Checklist

- [ ] Code follows the standards described in the README
- [ ] Names are clear and follow the naming conventions
- [ ] No `any`, magic numbers, `console.log`, or commented-out code
- [ ] Comments explain "why", not "what"
- [ ] Tests were added or updated
- [ ] Lint, typecheck, and tests pass locally
- [ ] Documentation was updated (if applicable)
- [ ] PR is small and focused on a single concern
